# Zustand Selector Stability Check

Assess selector behavior and rerender safety.

## Checks

- Stable selector outputs
- Avoided unnecessary object recreation
- Component subscription safety

## Output

```text
Selector Stability: pass | fail
Risks:
- <risk>
Mitigations:
- <action>
```
